  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const app = document.getElementById("app");
    const shelfButton = document.getElementById("shelfButton");
    const resetButton = document.getElementById("resetButton");

    // Renderer
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

    );

    // Scene and camera
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xeeeae2);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xeeeae2, 11, 24);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.05, 0);
    const defaultView = {
      theta: 0.58,
      phi: 1.16,
      radius: 8.4
    };

    const view = { ...defaultView };

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(view.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        cameraTarget.x + view.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(view.theta),
        cameraTarget.y + view.radius * Math.cos(view.phi),
        cameraTarget.z + view.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(view.theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(cameraTarget);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // Lighting
    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbf2, 0x806b59, 2.0);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3df, 3.2);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 8, 5.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 6;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 20;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00025;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xdce8f2, 1.1);
    fillLight.position.set(-5, 4, -3);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // Procedural wood texture
    function createWoodTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 128;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 128);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#c28452");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, "#a86337");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#7e4328");

      context.fillStyle = gradient;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 128);

      let seed = 81723;
      const random = () => {
        seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
        return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 125; i++) {
        const x = random() * 512;
        const width = 0.4 + random() * 2.3;
        const alpha = 0.025 + random() * 0.11;

        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(x, -10);
        context.bezierCurveTo(
          x + random() * 15 - 7.5,
          35,
          x + random() * 20 - 10,
          85,
          x + random() * 12 - 6,
          138
        );
        context.strokeStyle = `rgba(55, 25, 12, ${alpha})`;
        context.lineWidth = width;
        context.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const x = random() * 512;
        const y = random() * 128;

        context.beginPath();
        context.ellipse(x, y, 8 + random() * 17, 2 + random() * 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.strokeStyle = "rgba(64, 29, 14, 0.12)";
        context.lineWidth = 1.2;
        context.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(1.4, 1);
      texture.anisotropy = Math.min(
        8,
        renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy()
      );

      return texture;
    }

    const woodTexture = createWoodTexture();

    const materials = {
      wood: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xffffff,
        map: woodTexture,
        bumpMap: woodTexture,
        bumpScale: 0.018,
        roughness: 0.64,
        metalness: 0
      }),
      darkWood: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x815035,
        map: woodTexture,
        roughness: 0.72,
        metalness: 0
      }),
      metal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x9ba6aa,
        roughness: 0.28,
        metalness: 0.82
      }),
      darkMetal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x4b5357,
        roughness: 0.38,
        metalness: 0.7
      }),
      notch: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x492d1e,
        roughness: 0.8,
        metalness: 0
      })
    };

    function addMesh(geometry, material, parent = scene) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addBox(width, height, depth, material, position, parent = scene) {
      const mesh = addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, depth),
        material,
        parent
      );
      mesh.position.copy(position);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addCylinder(
      radius,
      height,
      material,
      position,
      parent = scene,
      radialSegments = 20
    ) {
      const mesh = addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          radius,
          radius,
          height,
          radialSegments
        ),
        material,
        parent
      );
      mesh.position.copy(position);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addBeam(start, end, width, thickness, material, parent = scene) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(length, thickness, width);
      const mesh = addMesh(geometry, material, parent);

      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );

      return mesh;
    }

    function roundedRectangleShape(width, height, radius) {
      const shape = new THREE.Shape();
      const x = -width / 2;
      const y = -height / 2;

      shape.moveTo(x + radius, y);
      shape.lineTo(x + width - radius, y);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + radius);
      shape.lineTo(x + width, y + height - radius);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(
        x + width,
        y + height,
        x + width - radius,
        y + height
      );
      shape.lineTo(x + radius, y + height);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + height, x, y + height - radius);
      shape.lineTo(x, y + radius);
      shape.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);

      return shape;
    }

    // Ground
    const ground = addMesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe8e4da,
        roughness: 0.96,
        metalness: 0
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -0.025;
    ground.castShadow = false;

    // Rack assembly
    const rack = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(rack);

    const leftX = -1.72;
    const rightX = 1.72;
    const topY = 4.25;
    const topHalfDepth = 0.72;
    const footZ = 1.3;

    // Two A-frame side supports made from flat wooden slats
    for (const x of [leftX, rightX]) {
      // Top cross slat
      addBeam(
        new THREE.Vector3(x, topY, -topHalfDepth),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, topY, topHalfDepth),
        0.19,
        0.16,
        materials.wood,
        rack
      );

      // Two angled legs
      addBeam(
        new THREE.Vector3(x, topY, -topHalfDepth),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.08, -footZ),
        0.19,
        0.16,
        materials.wood,
        rack
      );

      addBeam(
        new THREE.Vector3(x, topY, topHalfDepth),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.08, footZ),
        0.19,
        0.16,
        materials.wood,
        rack
      );

      // Small dark wooden feet
      for (const z of [-footZ, footZ]) {
        addBox(
          0.28,
          0.12,
          0.3,
          materials.darkWood,
          new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.035, z),
          rack
        );
      }
    }

    // Three slender rounded drying rails
    const railHeights = [1.28, 2.48, 3.68];
    const notchPositions = [-1.18, -0.59, 0, 0.59, 1.18];

    for (const y of railHeights) {
      const railShape = roundedRectangleShape(3.28, 0.16, 0.075);
      const railGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(railShape, {
        depth: 0.12,
        bevelEnabled: true,
        bevelThickness: 0.018,
        bevelSize: 0.018,
        bevelSegments: 3,
        curveSegments: 8,
        steps: 1
      });
      railGeometry.center();

      const rail = addMesh(railGeometry, materials.wood, rack);
      rail.position.set(0, y, 0);

      // Small recessed notches with visible metal pins
      for (const x of notchPositions) {
        const notch = addBox(
          0.18,
          0.026,
          0.17,
          materials.notch,
          new THREE.Vector3(x, y + 0.085, 0),
          rack
        );
        notch.castShadow = false;

        const pin = addCylinder(
          0.022,
